description: Budget estimate for machining a part from an STL: stock block, material removed, surface area, roughing and finishing time at the material removal rates given, and part mass. Based on volume and surface area only; holes and corner radii are not detected from STL. Accepts up to 60,000 triangles.

material.description: Preset (al6061, ms, ss304, brass, pom) or {name, density_g_cm3, rough_cm3_per_min, finish_cm2_per_min, price_per_kg}

pricing.description: Optional: turn the result into a price

name: estimate_cnc_from_stl
title: Estimate CNC machining of a 3D part (before CAM)
